environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running Node.js 18 directly. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with the 'webapp' user having SELECT privileges on all tables including 'users' (which contains password_hash, email, ssn columns). Application is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional filtering. The pg_stat_statements extension is enabled for monitoring but no query-level restrictions exist. The 'webapp' database role was granted: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO webapp;

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15.4, user 'webapp' with SELECT on all tables in public schema
config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough on port 443->3000
config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
config.db_tables: users(id, username, password_hash, email, ssn, role), reports(id, title, created_at, department, author_id, content)
